summary: The 2017 Cincinnati mayoral election was held on November 7, 2017, to choose the Mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio. Although officially nonpartisan, the top two candidates from the May 2 primary advanced to the general election regardless of party. Incumbent Democratic Mayor John Cranley won re-election to a second term.
one_line: Summary of the November 7, 2017 election in which incumbent John Cranley won re-election as Mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio.
key_facts: The 2017 Cincinnati mayoral election took place on November 7, 2017.
The election was held to elect the Mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio.
The top two candidates from the May 2 primary election advanced to the general election, regardless of party.
Incumbent Democratic Mayor John Cranley won re-election to a second term.
John Cranley was the incumbent mayor at the time of the 2017 election.
